title: Harry Potter
paragraphs: Harry James Potter is a half-blood wizard.
He defeated Lord Voldemort at the Battle of Hogwarts.
Hermione Granger is one of his best friends.
Ron Weasley is his other best friend.
He uses the spell Expelliarmus often.
Dobby the house-elf saved his life.
The Elder Wand is one of the Deathly Hallows.
Hogwarts is the school of witchcraft and wizardry.
